name: ZaoSeq Bopomofo v0.2 sealed TEST generation plan (TEST-V1)
written_before: any TEST-V1 sentence was authored, extracted or decoded

TEST-V1-EVERYDAY.authoring: New everyday Taiwan Mandarin sentences written for this TEST with AI assistance under project-owner direction, one category at a time from the category list above. Not taken from any corpus. Not written from, or as rewrites of, Coverage-DEV items, v0.1 TEST items, manual DEV / sanity seeds, the five Round 3 manual sanity inputs, or any DEV / Round 2 / Round 3 error case. No decoder, language model, lexicon or teacher is run on any sentence before the single sealed evaluation.
TEST-V1-EVERYDAY.phenomena: function_words and homophones include natural uses of 在/再, 的/得/地, 是/事, 已/以, 完/玩, 嗎/媽 and similar pairs as ordinary language, not as copies of known errors
TEST-V1-EVERYDAY.spares: each category is authored with up to 4 spare sentences after the first 30; a sentence removed by screening is replaced by the next spare of the same category in authored order; the first 30 surviving sentences per category are kept
TEST-V1-EVERYDAY.text: Han characters only (no punctuation or Latin letters); 4 to 30 characters; optional left_context for conversational items
TEST-V1-EVERYDAY.readings: Ministry of Education dictionary conventions as in v0.1 TEST-EVERYDAY: 一 and 不 carry their sandhi tones; sentence particles and suffixes (的 了 們 嗎 麼 呢 吧 啊 子 個 頭 when unstressed) carry the neutral tone where CNS11643 lists it, otherwise the CNS base tone; other characters use their dictionary tone. Every (character, reading) must exist in CNS11643. Readings are assigned from the text alone.
TEST-V1-EVERYDAY.acceptable: the text plus the global alternatives 你/妳 and 週/周; manual alternatives only where two spellings are equally standard; script variants are handled by CandidateFamily

TEST-V1-GOV.source: government corpus split 'dev', restricted to documents that contributed no item to v0.1 TEST-GOV (benchmarks/test/gov.jsonl)
TEST-V1-GOV.why_untouched: corpus split 'dev' was never used for LM or lexicon training, hard-negative mining, Laya fine-tuning or any DEV evaluation (GOV-DEV is split 'test'); within it only the 800 v0.1 TEST-GOV clauses were ever evaluated, and every document that contributed one is excluded
TEST-V1-GOV.legal_excluded: only 1 of the 71 legal 'dev' documents contributed no v0.1 TEST-GOV item (17 sentences), so legal cannot be sampled at document level; it is excluded and reported
TEST-V1-GOV.extraction: Han runs of 4 to 12 characters; left_context is the preceding text of the same sentence; readings from the rule-based annotator (builtin multi-character words, single-reading CNS characters, single-reading builtin characters); clauses with an ambiguous polyphone are rejected, never guessed
TEST-V1-GOV.sampling: deterministic order by sha256('v0.2-test-v1' + source_id + doc_id + clause); at most 3 clauses per document; up to 200 per domain (fewer if the eligible pool is smaller)

leakage_screening.method: daily.guard.EvaluationGuard: Han-only normalization, character 4-gram MinHash-LSH with exact Jaccard >= 0.6, plus shared-8-gram containment; exact duplicates are a special case
references: government corpus 'dev' split sentences of documents used by v0.1 TEST-GOV
daily corpus: Tatoeba train/dev/test, Common Voice 27.0 train/dev/test, OASST1 prompter (all retained sentences)
benchmarks/dev and benchmarks/sanity seeds (manual DEV / sanity)
the five Round 3 manual sanity inputs (daily.manual_sanity.INPUTS)
within TEST-V1: every EVERYDAY item against the other EVERYDAY items, and every GOV item against EVERYDAY and earlier GOV items
leakage_screening.rule: every flagged item is removed (EVERYDAY: replaced by the next spare); the reason and matched reference are written to benchmarks/test_v1/DEDUP_REPORT.json; the final sets must have 0 flagged items

outputs.manifest: benchmarks/test_v1/MANIFEST.json (per-file sha256, item counts, category distribution, methodology, created_at, source commit, semantic freeze sha256, gate sha256, dedupe summary)
outputs.seal: benchmarks/frozen/V0.2_SEALED.json locks the TEST files, manifest, plans, gate, semantic freeze and the evaluation code before the single run

not_built: no TYPO TEST in this stage
